title: Falsifiability of the substrate consistency window
html:
Remark. Falsifiability of the substrate consistency window

Significance. The overdetermination of q acts as a stringent test of the framework. Three independent measurement classes agree on the identical parameter. The consistency window [1.109, 1.112] remains narrow (\Delta q / q \approx 0.3\%) and tightens with observational precision. Any future measurement falling outside this window falsifies the framework.
